items.headline: Radiant World fallout hits trade finance banks
items.summary: Banks including Mizuho and Incomlend filed Singapore court claims against iron-ore trader Radiant World over alleged falsified documents, per GTR and Reuters, as counterparties keep withdrawing credit lines.

items.headline: Fraud case exposes cargo-document verification gaps
items.summary: Coverage of the Radiant World scandal highlights that trade finance depends on paperwork proving cargo ownership, and doubts over document validity can quickly freeze credit even while goods are moving.

items.headline: ACER consults on REMIT-EMIR derivatives reporting
items.summary: ACER's public consultation on a new Annex clarifying how energy derivatives should be reported under REMIT and EMIR, and how REMIT exemptions apply, runs until 11 September 2026.

items.headline: Panama Canal to cut daily transit slots
items.summary: From mid-September the Panama Canal will reduce booking capacity to 32 ships per day amid rainfall deficits, tightening Panamax availability and pushing up auction slot prices, per Seven Oceans.
